gameplay: Arcade shooter with fast-paced aerial combat
objetivo: Player must shoot down enemy aircraft and avoid being shot to progress
descripcion_corta: Flies at the speed of sound in this perfect conversion of SEGA’s classic 32X arcade game.
descripcion_larga: After Burner Complete is the definitive version of SEGA’s legendary aerial combat shooter. Powered by the Sega 32X hardware, this release delivers smoother frame rates and far more vibrant colors than the original Genesis/Mega Drive version. If you’re looking for fast-paced arcade action, lock-on missile combat, and an iconic soundtrack straight from the arcades, this is an essential 1995 title for any retro gaming collection.

nombre: After Burner Complete ~ After Burner (Japan, USA)
gameplay: Arcade shooter with fast-paced aerial combat
objetivo: Player must shoot down enemy aircraft and avoid being shot to progress
descripcion_corta: Flies at the speed of sound in this perfect conversion of SEGA’s classic 32X arcade game.
descripcion_larga: After Burner Complete is the definitive version of SEGA’s legendary aerial combat shooter. Powered by the Sega 32X hardware, this release delivers smoother frame rates and far more vibrant colors than the original Genesis/Mega Drive version. If you’re looking for fast-paced arcade action, lock-on missile combat, and an iconic soundtrack straight from the arcades, this is an essential 1995 title for any retro gaming collection.

nombre: Amazing Spider-Man, The - Web of Fire (USA)
gameplay: Side-scrolling beat 'em up with platforming elements
objetivo: Player controls Spider-Man to fight enemies and complete levels
descripcion_corta: Help Spider-Man stop Hydra in this rare and valuable side-scrolling action title for the 32X.
descripcion_larga: The Amazing Spider-Man: Web of Fire is one of the rarest and most sought-after games in the Sega 32X library. Developed by BlueSky Software, this action platformer puts you in control of the web-slinger with fluid animations and detailed stages. Battle against the Hydra organization and experience one of the most technically impressive finales on the system. A true cult classic and a must-have for Marvel collectors.

gameplay: Unique remix/mod with rhythm and platform elements
objetivo: Player completes challenges with rhythm timing and puzzle solving
descripcion_corta: The famous music video “Bad Apple!!” incredibly recreated inside the Sonic 1 engine for 32X.
descripcion_larga: Bad Apple!! in Sonic 1 is a modern homebrew technical showcase for the Sega 32X. By fully utilizing the console’s twin SH-2 processors, this port recreates the iconic Touhou music video with a level of fidelity once thought impossible on 1990s hardware. It’s a perfect demonstration of the hidden power of the system, ideal for fans of technical demos, retro hardware experiments, and Sonic the Hedgehog mods.

objetivo: Player races opponents in various tracks, aiming to finish first
descripcion_corta: Prehistoric racing full of humor and speed in the Chuck Rock universe for 32X.
descripcion_larga: BC Racers takes the crazy Stone Age racing concept to the next level with true 32-bit power. Designed by legendary creator Toby Gard, this game features colorful tracks, smooth object scaling, and competitive gameplay that blends high speed with combat. Race with your favorite cavemen in one of the most entertaining and visually impressive driving games on the SEGA 32X.

objetivo: Player navigates levels, defeats enemies, and solves puzzles to progress
descripcion_corta: Cinematic action and shooting in a dark fantasy world developed by Blizzard for 32X.
descripcion_larga: Blackthorne (also known as Blackhawk) stands out on the Sega 32X thanks to its mature atmosphere and cinematic platforming style. In this Blizzard Entertainment classic, you control Kyle Vlaros on a mission of revenge filled with intense gunfights and cover-based action. The 32X version shines with an expanded color palette and pre-rendered backgrounds, giving it a distinct visual edge over other console releases.

objetivo: Player fights opponents in one-on-one combat to win matches
descripcion_corta: Anthropomorphic animals clash in this bloody and enhanced fighting game for 32X.
descripcion_larga: Brutal Unleashed: Above the Claw is the enhanced version of the original fighting game, fully taking advantage of the Sega 32X’s improved color and sound capabilities. With new characters and over-the-top finishing moves, it delivers a bizarre, violent, and highly memorable combat experience. If you enjoy unconventional fighters with personality, this “Unleashed” edition is the definitive way to play.

objetivo: Player uses tether to navigate levels and collect items
descripcion_corta: Knuckles stars in a unique adventure with elastic tether mechanics and vibrant graphics.
descripcion_larga: Knuckles’ Chaotix is the flagship title of the Sega 32X and a technical gem within the Sonic universe. Its innovative “linked partners by a ring” system introduces unique physics-based mechanics and psychedelic, color-drenched stages. This is an essential game for understanding Knuckles’ legacy and enjoying one of the best soundtracks and visual showcases of the entire 16/32-bit era.

objetivo: Player fights in arenas to defeat opponents in combat rounds
descripcion_corta: Brutal space battles with fatalities and destructible armor in this 32X fighter.
descripcion_larga: Cosmic Carnage (known as Cyber Brawl in Japan) is a 2D fighting game famous for its massive sprites and impressive scaling effects. Set in a space prison, it allows players to customize fighters with armor that visibly breaks during combat. A visceral and distinctive title that highlights the Sega 32X’s ability to handle large, detailed graphics without slowdown.

objetivo: Player battles opponents using combos and special moves
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of Cosmic Carnage with human characters and 2D fighting action.
descripcion_larga: Cyber Brawl is the original Japanese edition of Cosmic Carnage, preserving the fighters’ human and alien designs. This Sega 32X fighting game is well known for its dynamic camera zoom and arcade-style gameplay. If you want to experience the uncensored version with the original difficulty balance, Cyber Brawl is a fascinating piece of SEGA’s 32-bit history.

objetivo: Player pilots a ship to destroy enemies and complete missions
descripcion_corta: An ambitious 3D space shooter that pushes the Sega 32X’s polygons to the limit.
descripcion_larga: Darxide is a technical milestone for the Sega 32X and one of the few games to make heavy use of textured polygons. Developed by Frontier Developments, this 3D space shooter challenges you to destroy asteroids and enemy fleets to save humanity. Due to its European-only release and impressive graphics, it is often considered the “holy grail” for fans of retro 3D gaming.

gameplay: Classic FPS with fast-paced shooting and exploration
objetivo: Player navigates levels, defeating enemies and finding keys to progress
descripcion_corta: The king of FPS comes to 32X with a smooth and fast version of the Mars massacre.
descripcion_larga: Doom on Sega 32X served as the gateway to first-person shooters for many console players. This European version delivers fast gameplay while preserving the iconic level design created by id Software. Although it is known for its screen border, the smooth movement and responsive controls make it one of the most enjoyable and nostalgic ways to experience Doom on original SEGA hardware.

gameplay: Classic FPS with fast-paced shooting and exploration
objetivo: Player navigates levels, defeating enemies and finding keys to progress
descripcion_corta: The legendary id Software shooter optimized for the twin chips of the Sega 32X.
descripcion_larga: Doom for Sega 32X is a landmark FPS on consoles. This Japanese and North American release uses the 32-bit hardware to deliver a rapid, intense gameplay experience. Despite the well-known screen frame, the fluid movement and visceral demon-slaying action on Mars make it an essential title for any serious SEGA or retro shooter collection.

gameplay: Enhanced and modified FPS version with updated levels
objetivo: Player completes missions by defeating monsters and clearing areas
descripcion_corta: An astonishing modern homebrew upgrade that takes Doom on 32X to a superior technical level.
descripcion_larga: Doom 32X Resurrection is a fan-driven project that redefines what the Sega 32X hardware can achieve. Version v2.2b fixes original bugs, adds high-quality music, enables full-screen display, and greatly improves the frame rate. It is the definitive modern way to enjoy classic Doom on original hardware or emulation, showcasing the true potential of the system.

objetivo: Player controls a soccer team to win matches and tournaments
descripcion_corta: The world’s most famous soccer simulator debuts with 32-bit graphics on SEGA’s add-on.
descripcion_larga: FIFA Soccer ‘96 arrived on the European Sega 32X with a major visual upgrade over the Mega Drive version. Featuring more detailed stadiums, smoother animations, and full official licenses of the era, it represented soccer’s leap into the 32-bit generation. A must-own sports classic for fans of mid-90s European football.

nombre: GameTap, Cup Noodles, and Bitter Tears
objetivo: Unknown objective (could be narrative or exploration based)
descripcion_corta: A curious and experimental piece of homebrew software that explores the creative limits of the 32X.
descripcion_larga: GameTap, Cup Noodles, and Bitter Tears is both a technical and artistic demonstration from the Sega 32X homebrew scene. Releases like this are highly valued by the community for their originality and unconventional use of hardware. It stands as a great example of the ongoing vitality of independent development for SEGA retro consoles.

objetivo: Player fights enemies through levels to defeat the evil tyrant
descripcion_corta: SEGA’s classic arcade game receives enhanced visuals in this 32X version.
descripcion_larga: Golden Axe 32X Edition is a reimagining of the legendary beat ’em up that takes advantage of the expanded color palette of the hardware. Players can relive the classic battle against Death Adder with more detailed backgrounds and visual effects not possible on the standard Genesis. A perfect blend of timeless arcade gameplay and 32-bit enhancement.

nombre: Golf Magazine 36 Great Holes Starring Fred Couples (Europe)
objetivo: Player aims to complete golf courses with as few strokes as possible
descripcion_corta: Professional golf simulation with digitized graphics and the signature of Fred Couples.
descripcion_larga: Golf Magazine 36 Great Holes delivers a realistic golf experience on the European Sega 32X. Thanks to the hardware, the game features smooth object scaling and more detailed course textures. With professional golfer Fred Couples’ involvement, it stands as one of the deepest and most visually impressive sports simulators on the add-on.

nombre: Golf Magazine 36 Great Holes Starring Fred Couples (Japan, USA)
objetivo: Player aims to complete golf courses with as few strokes as possible
descripcion_corta: The leading 32X golf simulator with hyper-realistic courses and pro-level gameplay.
descripcion_larga: This Japanese and North American version of Golf Magazine 36 Great Holes stands out for its digitized graphics and intuitive interface. By using the SH-2 processors to calculate accurate swing physics, the game offers 36 iconic holes and the challenge of playing as—or against—Fred Couples in one of the best 1990s golf simulations.

objetivo: Player uses tether to navigate levels and collect items
descripcion_corta: Knuckles’ exclusive adventure arrives in Europe with vibrant colors and cooperative gameplay.
descripcion_larga: Knuckles’ Chaotix is the most iconic title on the Sega 32X. In its European release, the game shines thanks to its innovative “elastic partner” system, enabling unique speed-based mechanics. With visuals that feel like a living cartoon and an unforgettable funk soundtrack, it is truly the crown jewel of SEGA’s 32-bit add-on library.

objetivo: Player uses tether to navigate levels and collect items
descripcion_corta: Explore SEGA’s development history with this early prototype of the 32X’s most famous game.
descripcion_larga: The Knuckles’ Chaotix prototype (February 2, 1995) is an invaluable historical artifact. This early build allows fans and digital archaeologists to discover unfinished mechanics, graphical differences, and in-development stages. It offers a fascinating look into the creative process behind one of SEGA’s most complex and colorful games, making it essential for Sega 32X preservation and retro research enthusiasts.

gameplay: Arcade ball-clacking game where players keep balls in motion
objetivo: Player competes to keep balls bouncing and score points
descripcion_corta: A fun physics-based mini-game set in the world of Knuckles’ Chaotix.
descripcion_larga: Knuckles’ Clackers is a technical curiosity focused on the collision systems and physics mechanics of Chaotix. While simple in concept, it serves as an excellent demonstration of how the Sega 32X handles multiple objects and sprites on screen with impressive smoothness. An ideal companion piece for fans who want to explore every corner of the Knuckles franchise.

gameplay: Unique hummingbird platformer with shooting mechanics
objetivo: Player navigates levels, defeating enemies and collecting items
descripcion_corta: A beautiful and unconventional shooter where you control a hummingbird to save nature.
descripcion_larga: Kolibri is widely considered one of the most visually stunning games on the Sega 32X. Created by the developers of Ecco the Dolphin, this unique shoot ’em up places you in control of a hummingbird within a lush natural world. With painterly backgrounds and a relaxing yet challenging atmosphere, it stands as a one-of-a-kind experience that alone justifies the existence of the add-on.

objetivo: Player pilots a mech to complete missions and defeat enemies
descripcion_corta: True 3D mecha combat with texture mapping in this technical powerhouse for 32X.
descripcion_larga: Metal Head was SEGA’s direct response to the growing demand for true 3D polygonal graphics. In this European release, you pilot a massive mech through detailed cities with full texture mapping, a revolutionary achievement for consoles at the time. It is a technical powerhouse that demonstrates the raw potential of the dual processors of the Sega 32X in combat simulation.

objetivo: Player pilots a mech to complete missions and defeat enemies
descripcion_corta: True 3D bipedal tank combat with unprecedented graphical power on 32X.
descripcion_larga: Metal Head for the Japanese and North American markets is a technological showcase that highlights the polygonal power of the Sega 32X. Pilot an advanced mech in urban peacekeeping missions with fully textured 3D environments. This version reflects SEGA’s original vision for robot combat, delivering an immersive atmosphere and a technical presentation that challenged contemporary consoles.

gameplay: Fighting game with special moves and fatalities
objetivo: Player wins matches by defeating opponents in combat
descripcion_corta: The ultimate fight comes to 32-bit with a near-perfect conversion of the original arcade game.
descripcion_larga: Mortal Kombat II on the European Sega 32X is considered by many to be the best home version of the 1990s. With richer colors, larger sprites, and superior audio compared to the Genesis edition, it delivers all the brutality of the arcade with remarkable accuracy. The Outworld tournament has never looked so good on SEGA hardware.

gameplay: Fighting game with special moves and fatalities
objetivo: Player wins matches by defeating opponents in combat
descripcion_corta: Blood, fatalities, and smooth action in the most powerful MKII version for the SEGA ecosystem.
descripcion_larga: Enjoy Mortal Kombat II on your Sega 32X (USA/Japan) with quality that rivals the arcade. This release takes advantage of the hardware to enhance backgrounds and improve animation fluidity for Liu Kang, Scorpion, and the rest of the roster. It is an essential title for fighting game fans seeking the most intense and technically impressive 32-bit-era experience.

objetivo: Player races motocross tracks aiming to finish first
descripcion_corta: Mud-filled motorcycle racing and acrobatic jumps on the European circuits of 32X.
descripcion_larga: Motocross Championship brings high-octane racing adrenaline to SEGA’s 32-bit add-on. Focused on speed and technical handling, this European version stands out for its challenging tracks and perspective that fully utilizes the Sega 32X’s scaling capabilities. Face off against rivals and dominate the podium in this classic retro motocross competition.

objetivo: Player races motocross tracks aiming to finish first
descripcion_corta: Feel the speed and the roar of the engines in this powerful Motocross simulator for 32X.
descripcion_larga: In Motocross Championship for the USA, the racing experience becomes even more intense thanks to 32-bit hardware. The game features multiple camera angles, bike customization, and improved jump physics over 16-bit versions. It’s an ideal title for extreme sports fans who want to see what SEGA’s “mushroom” add-on could truly deliver.

objetivo: Player wins basketball games by scoring more points than the opponent
descripcion_corta: “He’s on fire!” The world’s most famous arcade basketball game arrives with graphical enhancements on 32X.
descripcion_larga: NBA Jam: Tournament Edition is the definitive two-on-two basketball experience for SEGA fans. Featuring larger digitized players, additional NBA legends, and relentlessly fast-paced gameplay, this worldwide release uses the Sega 32X to overcome the color limitations of the Mega Drive, creating an unmatched audio-visual arcade spectacle.

gameplay: American football simulation focusing on quarterback play
objetivo: Player leads team to victory by executing plays and scoring touchdowns
descripcion_corta: The most complete American football simulation with realistic graphics and official licenses.
descripcion_larga: NFL Quarterback Club on Sega 32X raises the bar for retro sports games. With dynamic camera angles and detailed player sprites, it lets you experience the excitement of American football like never before. This worldwide version includes multiple game modes and deep gameplay systems that will satisfy fans of tactical, simulation-style football.

objetivo: Player commands a squad to complete missions and defeat enemies
descripcion_corta: The rebirth of a classic: isometric shooting and futuristic 3D action for 32X.
descripcion_larga: Parasquad (also known as Zaxxon's Motherbase 2000) reinvents the legendary Zaxxon franchise with full polygonal graphics. This isometric shooter introduces the ability to jump onto enemy ships and steal their abilities, adding a unique tactical layer. A visual gem of the Sega 32X that blends classic gameplay with cutting-edge mid-90s aesthetics.

objetivo: Player navigates levels, avoids obstacles, and solves puzzles
descripcion_corta: An exclusive look at Disney’s canceled game: the graphical potential of Pinocchio on 32X.
descripcion_larga: The Pinocchio prototype (December 6, 1995) is a treasure for lost media and prototype enthusiasts. Although it never reached retail shelves, this build shows how Disney planned to use the Sega 32X to enhance colors and scrolling layers beyond the 16-bit version. A rare historical piece that documents SEGA’s transition into the 32-bit era.

gameplay: Classic platformer with exploration and action
objetivo: Player explores jungles, avoids traps, and collects treasures
descripcion_corta: Harry Jr. returns in a jungle adventure with enhanced graphics and secret levels.
descripcion_larga: Pitfall: The Mayan Adventure on Sega 32X is the most visually rich version of this classic platformer. With a vibrant color palette that brings the Mayan jungle to life and fluid, cinematic-style animations, this USA release delivers a nostalgic journey filled with danger, vines, and hidden treasures powered by the system’s extra hardware muscle.

objetivo: Player fights opponents using special moves and combos
descripcion_corta: Dinosaurs and giant beasts fight for control of the Earth in this violent fighting game.
descripcion_larga: Primal Rage brings the brutality of prehistoric gods to the Sega 32X with astonishing arcade accuracy. Featuring digitized stop-motion graphics and devastating finishing moves, this version surpasses other releases of its time in color depth and visual detail. Dominate your rivals and rule humanity in this cult classic fighting game.

gameplay: Baseball simulation with real teams and players
objetivo: Player manages team and plays baseball games aiming to win
descripcion_corta: The classic of the diamond returns with updated stats and arcade-style gameplay on 32X.
descripcion_larga: RBI Baseball ’95 delivers a fast and accessible baseball experience for fans of the sport. This Sega 32X version enhances stadium visuals and player portraits while preserving the pick-up-and-play gameplay the series is known for. It’s the perfect title for quick matches infused with the atmosphere of Major League Baseball in 1995.

gameplay: Strategy RPG set in historical China
objetivo: Player manages resources and battles in turn-based combat
descripcion_corta: Deep strategy and historical conquest in the 32-bit version of Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
descripcion_larga: Sangokushi IV (Romance of the Three Kingdoms IV) on the Japanese Sega 32X represents the pinnacle of Koei’s historical strategy on SEGA hardware. With more detailed portraits, a refined interface, and optimized performance, this edition invites players to immerse themselves in ancient China and lead armies toward unification in a must-have tactical simulation.

objetivo: Player pilots spacecraft to complete missions and destroy enemies
descripcion_corta: Intense 3D space combat with smooth polygons and epic missions in space.
descripcion_larga: Shadow Squadron (known as Stellar Assault in Europe) is one of the finest space combat simulators of the 1990s. Powered by the Sega 32X polygon engine, it offers full 360-degree movement and massive capital ship battles. A perfect showcase of how the SH-2 processors could handle complex 3D environments with impressive frame rates.

gameplay: Platformer with Sonic characters in a space setting
objetivo: Player runs and jumps through levels defeating enemies and collecting rings
descripcion_corta: A galactic reinvention of the first Sonic, taking advantage of the color and power of the 32X.
descripcion_larga: Sonic 1 in Space is a creative hack that transports the classic Sonic the Hedgehog stages into outer space environments with expanded color palettes. Running on Sega 32X hardware, the game benefits from richer backgrounds and enhanced visual effects not possible on the original console, offering a fresh yet nostalgic experience for Sonic fans.

gameplay: Platformer featuring Sonic in a new adventure
objetivo: Player completes levels collecting rings and defeating bosses
descripcion_corta: An ambitious homebrew project imagining a futuristic sequel to Sonic for 32X.
descripcion_larga: Sonic 4: Cybernetic Outbreak is one of the most intriguing projects from the retro modding scene. This hack places Sonic in a darker, high-tech world, using the Sega 32X’s graphical capabilities to introduce new sprites, redesigned levels, and a technical soundtrack. It’s a prime example of how the community keeps SEGA’s 32-bit legacy alive.

gameplay: Platformer spin-off with new gameplay mechanics
objetivo: Player navigates levels using unique partner mechanics and collects items
descripcion_corta: The ultimate crossover: Sonic the Hedgehog joins the cast of Knuckles’ Chaotix.
descripcion_larga: Sonic in Chaotix allows players to experience the unique gameplay of Knuckles’ Chaotix while controlling Sonic himself. This hack seamlessly integrates the blue hedgehog into the elastic tether mechanics, revealing how SEGA’s icon would perform within the colorful and technically advanced world of the Sega 32X. An essential release for Sonic completionists.

objetivo: Player avanza en niveles usando habilidades de pareja para superar obstáculos y enemigos
descripcion_corta: The polished and enhanced version of the mod that brings Sonic into the Chaotix engine.
descripcion_larga: Sonic in Chaotix – Revision 2 improves Sonic’s integration into the flagship Sega 32X title. With corrected animations and tighter physics, this revision delivers a more stable and fluid experience. It is the most refined way to play Chaotix with the original hero of the series, fully taking advantage of the console’s extra processing power.

objetivo: Player controla nave para eliminar oleadas de enemigos y evitar ataques
descripcion_corta: An impressive space shooter prototype that promised to become a graphical benchmark on 32X.
descripcion_larga: Soulstar X is one of SEGA’s most famous “what if” projects. This prototype showcases a shooter with massive sprite scaling and pre-rendered graphics that pushed the Sega 32X to its limits. Exploring this build reveals a hidden technical gem that, although never released, proved the hardware could compete with the next console generation.

objetivo: Player vuela y dispara a enemigos mientras esquiva obstáculos en niveles verticales
descripcion_corta: Yu Suzuki’s classic “Into the Fantasy Zone” arrives in a perfect conversion for 32X.
descripcion_larga: Space Harrier in its European release is an “arcade perfect” port. Thanks to the dual processors, the Sega 32X handles the frantic object scaling and vibrant colors of the original 1985 arcade game with ease. It is a psychedelic, high-speed experience that every 32X owner should have to relive the golden age of the arcades.

objetivo: Player vuela y dispara a enemigos mientras esquiva obstáculos en niveles verticales
descripcion_corta: Enjoy the ultimate arcade action with this deluxe version of Space Harrier for 32X.
descripcion_larga: The Japanese and North American version of Space Harrier stands as proof of SEGA’s commitment to its classics. With a steady frame rate and astonishing visual accuracy, this edition surpasses all previous 8-bit and 16-bit ports. Fly over dragons and dodge towering pillars in one of the most iconic shooters in gaming history, now powered by true 32-bit hardware.

gameplay: Platformer featuring Spot as the main character
objetivo: Player supera niveles con saltos, recogiendo objetos y evitando enemigos
descripcion_corta: The 7-Up mascot jumps into isometric 3D in this advanced prototype for 32X.
descripcion_larga: Spot Goes to Hollywood in its Sega 32X prototype form offers an isometric perspective with far more detailed graphics than the Genesis version. Featuring stages inspired by classic film genres along with enhanced lighting and shadow effects, this is a valuable digital collectible that documents the transition of mascots from the 16-bit to the 32-bit era.

nombre: Star Trek Starfleet Academy - Starship Bridge Simulator (USA)
objetivo: Player gestiona diferentes sistemas de la nave para completar misiones
descripcion_corta: Take command of the bridge and graduate from the most prestigious academy in the galaxy.
descripcion_larga: Star Trek: Starfleet Academy – Starship Bridge Simulator is a deep simulation that puts your command skills to the test. On the Sega 32X, the game delivers digitized graphics and space combat sequences that leverage the system’s power to create an immersive science fiction atmosphere. An ideal choice for Trekkies seeking a tactical and authentic experience.

objetivo: Player pilota nave espacial para destruir enemigos y completar misiones
descripcion_corta: May the Force be with you! Pilot an X-Wing in this impressive arcade conversion.
descripcion_larga: Star Wars Arcade was one of the launch titles that demonstrated the 3D potential of the Sega 32X. In this European version, you can relive the assault on the Death Star with solid polygon graphics and exciting space combat gameplay. A historic release that brought SEGA’s arcade experience directly into the living room.

objetivo: Player pilota nave espacial para destruir enemigos y completar misiones
descripcion_corta: SEGA’s epic galactic battle comes to the Japanese 32X with 3D polygonal graphics.
descripcion_larga: Star Wars Arcade on Sega 32X is one of the most ambitious conversions on the hardware. Pilot an X-Wing or Y-Wing through asteroid fields and battle TIE fighters in true 3D. The Japanese version preserves the smoothness and excitement of the Model 1 arcade original, allowing fans to experience the Death Star trench run with remarkable technical power for 1994.

objetivo: Player pilota nave espacial para destruir enemigos y completar misiones
descripcion_corta: Feel the power of the Force with this spectacular 3D space shooter for the American 32X.
descripcion_larga: Star Wars Arcade was a key launch title that showed what SEGA’s “mushroom” add-on could do in the United States. Featuring a unique cooperative mode where one player pilots and the other shoots, this game delivers solid polygons and an iconic soundtrack. A cornerstone collectible for Star Wars fans and 32-bit retro hardware enthusiasts.

objetivo: Player controla nave en niveles de disparos para eliminar enemigos y avanzar
descripcion_corta: The ultimate 32X space shooter with cinematic combat and polygonal graphics.
descripcion_larga: Stellar Assault (known as Shadow Squadron in the West) shines in its Japanese release thanks to its technical gameplay and strong science fiction atmosphere. Using the dual SH-2 processors, it delivers smooth space battles and massive enemy ships with a clean, futuristic visual style. It is widely regarded as one of the finest 3D showcases in the Sega 32X library.

objetivo: Player pilota un tanque futurista para derrotar enemigos en combates vehiculares
descripcion_corta: Futuristic tank combat in a deadly arena with frantic action and 3D effects.
descripcion_larga: T-Mek brings the intensity of Atari’s arcade hit to the Sega 32X. In this first-person combat game, you maneuver your tank through dangerous arenas to defeat rival machines. Powered by the 32X, the game maintains a consistent frame rate and immersive sound effects, pulling you straight into a cyber-gladiator competition.

objetivo: Player avanza por niveles superando enemigos y obstáculos al ritmo de la música
descripcion_corta: An exclusive look at the development of the most musical and colorful game on the Sega 32X.
descripcion_larga: The Tempo prototype (December 29, 1994) allows players to explore early versions of the stages and mechanics from this rhythm-based platformer. It is a fascinating artifact for video game historians, showing how SEGA aimed to build a vibrant visual identity filled with fluid animation beyond the standard Genesis.

objetivo: Player avanza por niveles superando enemigos y obstáculos al ritmo de la música
descripcion_corta: A burst of rhythm, color, and platforming in the most charismatic game on the 32X system.
descripcion_larga: Tempo is pure visual joy. Playing as a stylish grasshopper, you’ll advance through music-filled stages packed with bizarre enemies. With an enormous color palette and cartoon-like animation, Tempo perfectly demonstrates how the Sega 32X could elevate 2D games to a professional arcade-quality level. A truly unique and rhythm-driven platformer.

objetivo: Player pelea en torneos de boxeo, usando técnicas y defensas para ganar
descripcion_corta: Visceral arcade boxing with the gritty style of the Toughman tournament on your 32X.
descripcion_larga: Toughman Contest delivers a first-person boxing experience with large, detailed sprites. This Sega 32X version improves color depth and animation fluidity over 16-bit releases, letting you feel every punch. With caricatured fighters and straightforward gameplay, it’s a fun sports title that captures the gritty spirit of 1990s Toughman competitions.

objetivo: Player pelea uno a uno usando combos y estrategias para ganar torneos
descripcion_corta: The 3D fighting revolution arrives in Europe with an astonishingly faithful arcade conversion.
descripcion_larga: Virtua Fighter on Sega 32X is a technical miracle. Successfully bringing Model 1 polygons into a home console with this level of smoothness was a major achievement. This European version delivers the full technical depth of Akira and the cast, and for many players, it was the definitive way to enjoy Virtua Fighter on SEGA hardware before the Saturn era.

objetivo: Player pelea uno a uno usando combos y estrategias para ganar torneos
descripcion_corta: SEGA’s legendary polygon fighter redefines the fighting genre on 32X.
descripcion_larga: Experience the precision and realism of Virtua Fighter on your Sega 32X (USA/Japan). This title broke away from 2D limitations and introduced true 3D fighting at home. With a solid frame rate and highly responsive controls, it remains a standout gem that proves the real purpose of SEGA’s 32-bit add-on.

gameplay: Adventure game starring a hamster protagonist
objetivo: Player controla un hámster explorando niveles y superando obstáculos
descripcion_corta: A unique and bizarre prototype of hamster racing through 3D polygonal tunnels.
descripcion_larga: Virtua Hamster is one of SEGA’s most famous canceled games. This prototype reveals the concept of controlling a hamster on a skateboard through textured 3D tunnels. It is an invaluable technical curiosity that showcases SEGA’s experimental spirit during the transition into the fifth console generation.

objetivo: Player compite en pistas variadas controlando autos en carreras rápidas
descripcion_corta: The definitive version of the racing classic with new cars and exclusive tracks.
descripcion_larga: Virtua Racing Deluxe expands upon the legend of the original arcade hit. This European version adds three vehicle classes (Formula, Stock, and Prototype) along with new tracks, using the Sega 32X to deliver smoother and more colorful polygons than the Genesis release. It is without question the best way to experience this 3D pioneer in 1994.

objetivo: Player compite en pistas variadas controlando autos en carreras rápidas
descripcion_corta: Elite polygonal speed in the most complete version of Virtua Racing for SEGA.
descripcion_larga: Virtua Racing Deluxe in Japan is synonymous with technical excellence. The game runs with impressive smoothness and delivers true “Deluxe” content that justifies owning the add-on. Whether racing time trials or mastering the new vehicles, it is a masterclass in how the Sega 32X could handle complex 3D graphics.

objetivo: Player compite en pistas variadas controlando autos en carreras rápidas
descripcion_corta: Burn rubber in true 3D with this enhanced edition of the racing hit for 32X.
descripcion_larga: The American version of Virtua Racing Deluxe is an absolute must-have. With multiple camera angles and the addition of touring cars and prototypes, it offers replay value beyond the arcade. It stands as a testament to SEGA’s golden era and mastery of polygon technology, perfectly adapted to 32-bit home hardware.

nombre: World Series Baseball Starring Deion Sanders (USA)
objetivo: Player juega partidos de béisbol, manejando bateo, lanzamiento y defensa
descripcion_corta: High-fidelity baseball with star Deion Sanders and 32-bit graphics.
descripcion_larga: World Series Baseball on Sega 32X takes sports realism a step further. Featuring Deion Sanders’ likeness and more detailed rendered stadiums, this version delivers deep gameplay systems and complete statistics. The extra hardware power results in more natural batting and pitching animations for true fans of the diamond.

objetivo: Player controla luchadores y compite en combates de wrestling
descripcion_corta: The world’s most famous wrestling promotion with more wrestlers and better graphics on 32X.
descripcion_larga: WWF Raw on Sega 32X is the “powered-up” version of the 16-bit classic. With more characters on screen, richer colors, and exclusive special moves, it delivers the definitive World Wrestling Federation experience for SEGA fans. Step into the ring with The Undertaker, Bret Hart, or Shawn Michaels and dominate the squared circle.

objetivo: Player pelea combates arcade con movimientos exagerados y efectos especiales
descripcion_corta: Frenetic action and impossible combos in this hybrid of wrestling and fighting game.
descripcion_larga: WWF WrestleMania: The Arcade Game on Sega 32X captures the insanity of Midway’s original arcade release. Unlike the 16-bit versions, this edition features larger, smoother sprites while preserving the fast-paced, Mortal Kombat-style combat with WWF superstars. Pure arcade adrenaline on your home console.

objetivo: Player controla mutantes X-Men para derrotar enemigos y avanzar niveles
descripcion_corta: An exclusive glimpse at what could have been the mutants’ adventure in the 32-bit era.
descripcion_larga: The X-Men prototype for Sega 32X is a relic of canceled software. Although never completed, it reveals how SEGA planned to use the expanded color palette and processing power of the system to bring Wolverine and the team into the 32-bit era. A fascinating historical piece for Marvel fans and SEGA preservationists alike.
